backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implementation; placeholder backend file.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three SEO-focused features: FAQ section addition, 'best sofa cleaning Ahmedabad' keyword integration, and Ahmedabad locality keywords incorporation across landing page components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend components describing layout, styling (Royal Blue/Gold theme), SEO enhancements, scroll animations, and premium design system usage across landing page sections.
frontend/index.css: Empty CSS file; global styles are defined in frontend/src/index.css instead.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO metadata (title, description, keywords for 'best sofa cleaning Ahmedabad' and locality names), Open Graph tags, and LocalBusiness JSON-LD structured data covering Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar service areas.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component composing the landing page layout with Header, Hero, and performance-optimized sections (ServiceCoverageBanner, Services, WhyChooseUs, AppointmentFormSection, LivePhotos, AreasServed, FAQSection, GoogleReviewsSection, Footer, FloatingContactButtons) wrapped in I18nProvider.
frontend/src/components/chat/SupportChat: Empty file; support chat widget component is not implemented or content was truncated.
frontend/src/components/common/IconBadge: Reusable icon wrapper component with configurable size (sm/md/lg) and variant (default/primary/secondary/accent/muted), applying Royal Blue/Gold premium styling with enhanced stroke weight and gradient backgrounds.
frontend/src/components/common/InlineIco: Simple inline icon wrapper component applying the 'inline-icon' CSS class to Lucide icons for consistent inline rendering.
frontend/src/components/common/LogoWithB: Logo component rendering the Magical Service logo image with configurable size (sm/md/lg) and premium backing container styling.
frontend/src/components/floating/Floatin: Fixed-position floating buttons for WhatsApp (green) and phone call (Royal Blue gradient) with premium shadows, hover animations, and responsive sizing.
frontend/src/components/landing/Appointm: Appointment booking form with validation for name, phone, service, area, date, and time fields; generates WhatsApp booking URL on submit and includes i18n support with scroll reveal animation.
frontend/src/components/landing/AreasSer: Displays a comprehensive list of service areas in Ahmedabad (90+ areas) and Gandhinagar (40+ sectors/localities) with scroll reveal animations. Uses MapPin icon badge and grid layout to showcase geographic coverage.
frontend/src/components/landing/FAQSecti: Renders an accordion-based FAQ section with internationalization support, displaying common questions about cleaning services. Uses scroll reveal animations with staggered delays for each FAQ item.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Footer component with company info, quick navigation links, contact details (phone, location, hours), and social media links (WhatsApp, Instagram, Google Business). Includes scroll reveal animation.
frontend/src/components/landing/GoogleRe: Displays Google business rating (5-star, 210+ reviews) with sample customer testimonials in card format. Features scroll reveal animations with staggered delays and a link to the full Google Business Profile.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Sticky header with logo, navigation menu, language selector (English/Hindi/Gujarati), and CTA buttons (Call, WhatsApp, Instagram). Includes mobile sheet menu and smooth scroll navigation to page sections.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Hero section component displaying a full-width banner with background image, headline, description, feature chips (hygienic, quick-dry, reviews), a "Why Choose Magical" benefits block, and CTA buttons for phone and WhatsApp contact.
frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhot: Gallery section displaying a grid of six live service photos (sofa, carpet, mattress, chair cleaning) with optional badges for before/after or special labels, using scroll reveal animations.
frontend/src/components/landing/ServiceC: Banner section showing service coverage areas with a map pin icon, heading, and a large image illustrating coverage in Ahmedabad and Gandhi Nagar for residential and commercial properties.
frontend/src/components/landing/Services: Services section listing five cleaning services (sofa, carpet, chair, mattress, AC) as themed cards with icons, descriptions, pricing, and a featured sofa price calculator component, using scroll reveal animations.
frontend/src/components/landing/SofaPric: Interactive calculator card allowing users to adjust sofa size via slider (5-25 ft) and see estimated price at ₹90/ft, with CTA buttons for phone and WhatsApp contact.
frontend/src/components/landing/WhyChoos: Feature section displaying four benefit cards (eco-friendly, German machines, gold standard, certified experts) in a grid layout with icons and descriptions, using scroll reveal animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook managing backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, using React Query to cache the actor instance and invalidate dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Custom React hook that detects and tracks the user's prefers-reduced-motion media query preference, returning a boolean state that updates on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollReveal.ts: Custom hook implementing scroll-triggered reveal animations using Intersection Observer and Web Animations API, with support for staggered children, reduced motion preferences, and proper cleanup.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: React context provider for internationalization supporting English, Hindi, and Gujarati locales with localStorage persistence and document language attribute management.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the complete translation structure covering all UI sections (header, hero, services, forms, FAQ, etc.) across supported locales.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Simple hook wrapper that accesses the I18nContext and throws an error if used outside the I18nProvider.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives defining a royal blue and gold color palette using OKLCH color space, premium box styling utilities, and dark mode support.
frontend/src/lib/whatsappBooking.ts: Utility functions to format booking appointment details into a structured WhatsApp message and generate pre-filled WhatsApp URLs for customer bookings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH color variables, custom border radii, service-specific colors, premium shadow utilities, and typography/animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking for a bilingual (English+Gujarati) marketing website for Magical Sofa Cleaning service targeting Ahmedabad & Gandhinagar. Contains architectural notes, known scope conflicts (AI features, external assets, language requirements), existing features, and requirement history across 119 versions.
